  "reasons": [
    "Table F prescribes that interest on calls in arrears may be charged at a rate not exceeding 10% p.a.",
    "Interest payable = Rs 4,000 * 10% * (6 / 12) = Rs 200.",
    "Rs 240 mistakenly applies the 12% p.a. maximum rate prescribed for calls in advance."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",

      "status": "explicit",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Table F maximum rate on calls in arrears is 10% per annum",

    {
      "option": "D",

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 240",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "If the articles are silent in this regard, the rule contained in Table F shall be applicable which states that the interest at a rate not exceeding 10% p.a. shall have to be paid on all unpaid amounts on shares for the period intervening between the day fixed for payment and the time of actual payment thereof.",
      "reason": "Uses 12% p.a. instead of 10% p.a., yielding Rs 240 instead of Rs 200."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "A shareholder failed to pay a call of Rs 4,000 on the due date and paid it after 6 months.",
      "reason": "Rs 4,000 * 10% * (6/12) equals Rs 200."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 400",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "A shareholder failed to pay a call of Rs 4,000 on the due date and paid it after 6 months.",
      "reason": "Fails to prorate for 6 months, giving Rs 400 instead of Rs 200."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 480",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "If the articles are silent in this regard, the rule contained in Table F shall be applicable which states that the interest at a rate not exceeding 10% p.a. shall have to be paid on all unpaid amounts on shares for the period intervening between the day fixed for payment and the time of actual payment thereof.",
      "reason": "Applies 12% p.a. for a full year, giving Rs 480 instead of Rs 200."
    }
  ]
